Class OrderingTrendsPage.XReport

java.lang.Object
OrderingTrendsPage.XReport
Enclosing class:
OrderingTrendsPage
private static final class OrderingTrendsPage.XReport extends Object
Generates today's X-report, which summarizes hourly sales activity, daily transaction totals, and sales grouped by payment method.

The report includes sales, returns, voids, and discards. It reads existing database records without modifying them and can be generated repeatedly throughout the day.

    • SUMMARY_SQL

      private static final String SUMMARY_SQL
      SQL query that retrieves today's transaction totals and sales totals grouped by payment method.

      The query returns a summary row joined with one row per payment method used for sales. If there are no sales, the summary is still returned with null payment method fields.

  • Method Details

    • show

      public static void show(Component parent, Connection connection)
      Builds today's X-report and displays the hourly activity table beside the daily transaction totals and sales by payment method.

      Displays a database error message if the report cannot be generated.

      Parameters:
      parent - the parent component for the report dialog
      connection - the database connection used to retrieve report data

    • loadHours

      private static Style.ReadOnlyTableModel loadHours(Connection connection, int currentHour) throws SQLException
      Builds the hourly activity table from opening until the current hour, including quiet hours with zero values, any other hours containing orders, and a total row at the bottom.

      If the store has not opened yet and there is no activity, displays a message instead of a total row.

      Parameters:
      connection - the database connection used to retrieve hourly activity
      currentHour - the current hour in 24-hour time
      Returns:
      a read-only table model containing the hourly activity and totals
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the hourly activity query fails

      Parameters:

      label - the hour interval or total-row label
      activity - the transaction counts and sales total to display

    • formatHour

      private static String formatHour(int hour)
      Formats a 24-hour clock hour for the report's hourly intervals, such as "8 AM" or "1 PM".
      Parameters:
      hour - the hour to format, from 0 to 23
      Returns:
      the formatted hour in 12-hour time

    • buildSummary

      private static String buildSummary(ResultSet result) throws SQLException
      Builds the daily summary text from the summary query result.

      Includes sales totals, net sales after returns, returns, voids, discards, and sales grouped by payment method. The supplied result set must initially be positioned on its first row.

      Parameters:
      result - the result set returned by the summary query
      Returns:
      the formatted daily summary
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a required summary value cannot be retrieved
